newsitem.title: TURKEY: Rebel Kurds kill five in eastern Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Rebel Kurds kill five in eastern Turkey.

text.p: Thousands of Turkish soldiers backed by helicopter gunships on Sunday hunted rebel Kurds who killed five people and wounded five in overnight attacks in eastern Turkey, security officials said.

Guerrillas of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) attacked a building belonging to the state bank Etibank late on Saturday in the eastern province of Elazig, killing four guards and a civilian, the security officials said.
"And they ambushed a military convoy on its way to the scene of the attack and wounded five soldiers," a security official in Elazig told Reuters by telephone.
"We have begun an operation backed by Sikorsky helicopters, involving around 3,000 soldiers," the official said.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in Turkey in the 12 years of fighting between the army and the PKK which is seeking independence or autonomy in southeast Turkey.
